literal_meaning: জনসমূহের বাসস্থান (people's abode or land of people)
figurative_meaning_en: Rural area; provincial or mofussil (regions away from urban centers)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি জনপদে বাস করে, শহরের হট্টগোল থেকে দূরে।
example_sentences_in_english: He lives in the mofussil, far from the city's hustle and bustle.
Life in the rural provinces is simple and peaceful.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'janapada', originally referring to ancient tribal settlements or kingdoms in Indian subcontinent, later adapted in Bengali to denote rural or provincial areas.
note: This term is more of a cultural descriptor than a vivid idiom, often used in literature to contrast urban and rural life.
